agent.problem: The correct answer covers only the first part of Joel 1:3. No card includes the children telling their children, and their children telling the next generation, so the verse's important command to pass the account down through successive generations is lost.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.

agent.problem: This non-opening story card has three sentences: the description of the ruined field, "No grain AND no oil?", and the bakery punchline. Non-opening story cards are limited to one or two sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: The closing clause about the prophet reaching out to the LORD retells Joel's call in Joel 1:19, but the card cites only Joel 1:20. The citation is too narrow for everything the card uses.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
